places.name: FAS and SEAS classrooms
places.wait: Email confirmation, usually 24–48 hours. Not instant.
places.who: Faculty, staff, and graduate students sign in with a NetID. Undergraduate organizations request rooms through Yale Connect.

places.name: Law School classrooms
places.wait: Request at least 48 hours ahead. Confirmed by email.
places.who: Yale Law students, faculty, and staff.

places.name: School of Public Health rooms
places.wait: Meetings need 24 hours. Events need 10 business days.
places.who: Current YSPH faculty, staff, and students.

places.name: Medical campus and Medical Library
places.wait: Depends on the room. The calendar is behind CAS.
places.who: Anyone with a NetID, but the rooms you can see depend on your role.

places.name: School of Management interview rooms
places.wait: Opens 7 days ahead. Check in on the pad or the hold drops.

places.name: Residential college rooms
places.wait: Written permission. There is no shared calendar.
places.who: Student groups need approval from that college's Head of College.

places.name: Bass open study
places.who: The courtyard level is the bright, often-busy floor, with carrels and the service desk. The lower level is quieter. Individual rooms other than C10F and C12A are first-come and are not on the live calendar. Drinks only, in a spill-proof container.

places.name: Haas reading room
places.who: Both levels are open seating: tables, armchairs, and couches. Rooms 108 and B36 are the ones you reserve.

places.name: Marx open study
places.wait: No reservation. The Young Family Study is open 24 hours.
places.who: The concourse has whiteboards and movable tables. The main study room has scanners and the public computers, including Bloomberg. A Yale ID is required to swipe into Kline Tower.

places.name: Sterling open reading rooms
places.who: Starr Reference Room, on the ground floor, is the quiet room. The Nave has soft seating and computers. Linonia and Brothers is for leisure reading. Subject reading rooms are first-come when a class is not in them. Room 226 is swipe access for graduate and professional students only.

places.name: Divinity reading rooms
places.who: Day Missions and Trowbridge are on floor 2. The upper level of Day Missions is stairs only. Four carrels in the Latourette Learning Center, on floor 1, are first-come and not soundproof.

places.name: Classics Library
places.who: A small library on floor 5 of Phelps Hall. Open as a study space to anyone with a current Yale ID.

places.name: Medical Library reading rooms
places.wait: No reservation for the reading rooms.
places.who: Morse Reading Room is silent study and open to the whole Yale community. A 24-hour space needs a Yale ID to swipe in. Group rooms here are on the EMS calendar, not the live library board.

places.name: Poorvu Center classrooms
places.wait: Approved by the center. Not a live calendar.
places.who: Instructors from FAS and the professional schools.
